headline.purpose: The cédula, the Expediente's one identity headline. B612, not mono — running text, not a column figure.

label.purpose: Caps-with-tracking semantic tags: page keys, nav groups, table headers, status badges, annunciator key labels.

figure.purpose: Column-aligned numeric data and discrete counters (table columns, pagination, annunciator totals). Never for standalone inline numbers.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions and the warning-stack sweep.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes on buttons, keys, inputs.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The one authored motion moment: the warning-to-credential sweep highlight.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ramp-inverted fill; rendered primary only when the current role and credential state actually allow the action (e.g. issuance with no open block).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #f5f6f7; color: #07090b; border-color: #f5f6f7; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4d545b; border-color: #4d545b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #07090b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: transparent; color: #4d545b; border-color: #dde0e3; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline button for non-primary actions (e.g. Registrar bloqueo).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #07090b; border: 1px solid #6b737a; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #dde0e3; border-color: #343a40; }

components.name: Status Lamp — Bloqueada
components.description: 24px lamp with a 45° diagonal hatch fill and a lock icon; the only lamp variant using a gradient/pattern, always paired with the text label.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-lamp-bloqueada { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #d12f24 0, #d12f24 4px, #a8241b 4px, #a8241b 8px); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Lamp + uppercase label + optional mono detail; never color alone.
components.html: Activa245 días
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-lamp-activa { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #4d545b; } .ds-badge-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #07090b; } .ds-badge-detail { font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; font-size: 12.5px; color: #4d545b; }

components.name: Page Key
components.description: Square-cornered hairline pill; selected key gets the ramp-inverted fill. A key with an open problem carries a mini lamp.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid #6b737a; background: transparent; color: #07090b; font-family: 'B612', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-key:hover:not([aria-selected='true']) { background: #dde0e3; border-color: #343a40; } .ds-key[aria-selected='true'] { background: #07090b; color: #f5f6f7; border-color: #07090b; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Hairline outline field; invalid state doubles the border to 2px in foreground color rather than turning red.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #6b737a; background: #ffffff; color: #07090b; font-family: 'B612', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #343a40; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #07090b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #07090b; border-width: 2px; }

components.name: Warning Stack Row
components.description: Full-width 44px button row: lamp, uppercase title, detail, right-aligned figure. Selecting it triggers the sweep-in highlight on linked credential rows elsewhere on the page.
components.css: .ds-warning-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 16px; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #dde0e3; background: transparent; color: #07090b; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; } .ds-warning-row:hover { background: #dde0e3; } .ds-warning-title { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-warning-detail { font-size: 12.5px; color: #4d545b; }

components.name: List Console Query Field
components.description: Full-width 56px lookup field for list pages; a deliberate exception to the 36–44px control scale. Shows a trailing '/' key-cap hint until the field has a value.
components.html: /
components.css: .ds-query { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-query-input { width: 100%; height: 56px; padding: 0 48px 0 48px; border: 1px solid #6b737a; border-radius: 2px; background: #ffffff; color: #07090b; font-family: 'B612', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-query-input:hover { border-color: #343a40; } .ds-query-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #07090b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-query-keycap { position: absolute; right: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid #6b737a; border-radius: 2px; color: #4d545b; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Annunciator Key
components.description: One of four equal lamp keys (Bloqueada, Vencida, Próxima a vencer, Activa); pressing filters results to that state and sorts by days remaining. Pressed key takes the ramp-inverted fill.
components.css: .ds-annunciator-key { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #6b737a; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #07090b; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-annunciator-key:hover { background: #dde0e3; } .ds-annunciator-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #07090b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-annunciator-key[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #07090b; color: #f5f6f7; border-color: #07090b; } .ds-annunciator-label { flex: 1; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-annunciator-total { font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
SRYG reads like a cockpit crew-alerting system, not a records app. An open credential problem is a warning message that never leaves the top of the screen, ranked by priority, and each license, rating, or medical certificate is a condition line the crew can inspect. The system refuses the category default it was built against: no sidebar of KPI cards, no tabbed card layout, no colored pills. Density and legibility come before decoration; the interface must read as precise and credible before it reads as friendly, matching INAC's institutional character.

The build is monochrome by discipline: one eleven-step cool-neutral ramp (--n-0 … --n-10) supplies every background, text, border, and control state, in both day and night variants. Hue is reserved entirely for status lamps — nowhere else. There are no shadows outside the one dialog surface, no glow, no gradients except the single repeating 45° hatch that marks a blocked lamp. Corners are square to 2px at most. The one authored motion moment — a linked-row sweep when a warning is selected — is deliberate and singular, not a house transition style.
keyCharacteristics: Single neutral ramp for all surfaces and text; color exists only in status lamps.
B612 for running text and labels; B612 Mono strictly for column-aligned figures in tables and pagination.
Square corners (0–2px), hairline 1px rules, no shadows outside the confirm dialog.
One signature motion: a warning-to-credential sweep highlight, exponential ease-out, reduced-motion safe.
Status is never color alone: every lamp pairs a fill/outline treatment with an icon and a text label.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every background, surface, border, and text color in the system resolves to a step of the single 11-step neutral ramp. A new component that reaches for a color outside --n-0…--n-10 or the three status hues is off-system.

rules.name: The Hue-Is-A-Verdict Rule
rules.body: Color never decorates. The only chromatic values in the build are the three status lamp colors (red, amber, unlit-neutral), and they appear nowhere except lamps, badges, and the blocked-row hatch — never as a border stripe, background tint, or brand accent.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-For-Columns Rule
rules.body: B612 Mono is reserved for figures that sit in an aligned column (table cells, pagination) or a discrete counter (the annunciator's totals). A standalone inline number — the cédula headline, an audit timestamp in running prose, a lone one-character badge detail — stays in B612 with tabular-nums, because B612 Mono's punctuation renders a full monospace cell and reads wrong outside a grid or counter.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow appears anywhere in the system except as a 1px inset outline (lamp rims, focused/highlighted rows) or the dialog backdrop. Depth is conveyed by ramp contrast and rules, not elevation.

dos: Do keep every surface, text, and border color on the single --n-0…--n-10 ramp; remap only the semantic assignment between day and night, never the ramp values themselves.

Do reserve B612 Mono for column-aligned figures (table cells, pagination) and discrete counters (the annunciator's totals); use B612 with tabular-nums for standalone inline numbers (cédula headline, audit timestamps, badge details).
Do pair every status indicator with a lamp, an icon, and a text label — never color alone.
Do keep the primary button contextual to what the current role and state actually allow; disable it in place rather than hiding or reassigning it when an action is blocked.
Do keep corners at 2px or square, and reserve the diagonal hatch pattern for the Bloqueada state only.

Do use the lookup-console grammar (breadcrumb + title + single primary action, full-width query field, annunciator panel, idle hint, dense table with responsive column drops) for list-style pages; it is a sibling to the Expediente's warning stack, not a KPI-card dashboard.
Do keep list-page chrome (breadcrumb, title, primary action, toolbar) present and reachable in loading and error states so the page never reflows on resolve.
donts: Don't introduce a shadow anywhere but the confirm dialog's backdrop scrim, or a glow of any kind — depth comes from ramp contrast and hairline rules.
Don't add a second hue-bearing UI element (a colored border stripe, a tinted card, a brand accent color) outside the three status lamp colors.
Don't invent kickers, eyebrows, or card/KPI layouts for new surfaces — the system's page-level grammar is the warning stack, the page keys, or the list console, not a dashboard-card default.
Don't style a second element with the ramp-inverted "primary" fill on the same view; it marks exactly one active/primary target (button, nav item, page key, or annunciator key) at a time.
